title: Open the bracket, or divide it away

ask.text: Author a claim on this site that closes at 2.

hints.text: One lock, several wards. Whatever the outside takes, every ward takes.
The far pan is the site. You are authoring the near one.
Whatever you write, seating 2 has to leave the Sill level.

worldFraming.text: A lock with identical wards. Open the bundle, or share the whole lock. Both reach the same tooth.

ask.text: Close it.

hints.text: One lock, several wards. Whatever the outside takes, every ward takes.
Open the bundle, or share the whole lock by 3. Both reach the same tooth.
Shared by 3, the far pan reads -2 and the ward still carries -8.

worldFraming.text: Fourth Rung. One route takes half as long and nobody will tell you which.

ask.text: Name the joint that will not hold, and what it should read.

hints.text: One lock, several wards. Whatever the outside takes, every ward takes.
Read down the working. One line does not follow from the one above it.
Line 2 is where the load stops matching.
